source.article: Molleman et al. (2020), Strategies for Integrating Disparate Social Information
source.supplement: Tables S1 and S2 and Supplementary Methods

findings.main_hypothesis: Social information use is highest when peer estimates have low variance and no skew.

reported_statistics.location: Main text Figure 1F and Supplementary Table S1

findings.main_hypothesis: With high peer variance, participants adjust more when two peers cluster close to their first estimate than when two peers cluster far from it.
Peer distributions shift the frequencies of keeping, adopting the nearest estimate, compromising, and other revisions.
Four-peer control estimates are closer to the arithmetic mean than revisions made after participants form their own visual estimate.

reported_statistics.direction: control absolute deviation from arithmetic mean is lower than main-task deviation
reported_statistics.location: Main text and Supplementary Figures S2-S4

required_tests.description: Every participant passes the three source-derived comprehension checks and completes five one-peer, 30 main, and five four-peer rounds in the published counterbalanced order using source-derived peer rules.
Condition means approximate reported social-information-use values and preserve LN > HC > HN/HF.
Compromise is more frequent in LN than HN and in HC than HF.
Control estimates are closer to the peers' arithmetic mean than main-task revisions.

source_limitations: The public LIONESS package references animal sprites hosted outside OSF; those URLs no longer resolve. The runtime uses deterministic regenerated silhouettes while preserving exact species and counts.

The original browser displayed each image for six seconds and collected slider movement. A vision-capable LLM receives the image in one turn, so the semantic task is preserved but visual exposure duration and motor behavior are not.
The original one-peer block is included for session fidelity but is excluded from focal behavioral-alignment scoring because the paper states that its results are not reported.
The original comprehension pages allowed participants to correct answers interactively. The agent runtime permits three attempts and then terminates the session fail-closed.
The package evaluates behavioral condition patterns and does not fit the paper's hierarchical cognitive model.
